tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a form-level metadata attribute not represented as a discrete leaf element in the Schedule SE MeF schema candidate list.

filer_name.rationale: PersonNm maps directly to the 'Name of person with self-employment income' field at the top of Schedule SE.

filer_ssn.rationale: SSN maps directly to the 'Social security number of person with self-employment income' field on Schedule SE.

section_used.rationale: The schema differentiates sections via xpath context (ShortScheduleSE vs. LongScheduleSE paths) rather than a single categorical indicator element; no single candidate represents this choice.

section_a_net_farm_profit.rationale: NetFarmProfitLossAmt (idx 8) exists but its xpath does not indicate ShortScheduleSE context; without a disambiguating path for Section A vs. Section B, a confident match cannot be made without risking incorrect assignment.

section_a_conservation_reserve_payments.rationale: ConservationReserveProgPymtAmt (idx 3) exists but has no xpath prefix to distinguish Section A (Short) from Section B (Long) usage.

section_a_net_nonfarm_profit.rationale: NetNonFarmProfitLossAmt (idx 9) exists but lacks a ShortScheduleSE xpath prefix to confirm it belongs to Section A rather than Section B.

section_a_combined_income.rationale: CombinedSEAmt (idx 1) or SETotalNetEarningsOrLossAmt under ShortScheduleSE (idx 16/30 area) could apply, but without a clear ShortScheduleSE-scoped combined-line element, a confident match is not possible.

section_a_se_tax.rationale: SelfEmploymentTaxAmt (idx 29) exists but is not scoped to ShortScheduleSE in the candidate list, making disambiguation from the Long SE tax impossible.

section_a_se_deduction.rationale: DeductibleSelfEmploymentTaxAmt (idx 4) exists but is not scoped to ShortScheduleSE, preventing confident assignment to Section A specifically.

section_b_net_farm_profit.rationale: NetFarmProfitLossAmt is the best available candidate for farm profit/loss; assigned to Section B by process of elimination given no ShortScheduleSE-prefixed version exists in the candidate list.

section_b_conservation_reserve_payments.rationale: ConservationReserveProgPymtAmt is the only candidate for Conservation Reserve Program payments and is assigned to Section B by default.

section_b_net_nonfarm_profit.rationale: NetNonFarmProfitLossAmt is the only candidate for non-farm profit/loss and is assigned to Section B by default.

section_b_combined_income.rationale: CombinedSEAmt is the best candidate for the sum of farm, conservation, and non-farm amounts in Section B.

section_b_church_employee_income.rationale: W2WagesFromChurchesAmt directly represents wages from churches not subject to Social Security/Medicare withholding, the primary Long SE church income line.

section_b_net_earnings_adjusted.rationale: SETotalNetEarningsOrLossAmt (non-ShortScheduleSE xpath) represents the net SE earnings figure after the 92.35% adjustment in the Long Schedule SE context.

section_b_social_security_wage_base.rationale: The Social Security wage base cap printed on the form (e.g., $160,200) is a static reference value with no corresponding leaf element in the candidate list.

section_b_taxable_ss_wages_and_tips.rationale: TotalWagesAndUnreportedTipsAmt maps to the Section B line for total Social Security wages plus unreported tips used to determine remaining wage base.

section_b_wage_base_remainder.rationale: WagesSubjectToSSTAmt represents the remaining Social Security wage base after subtracting wages already subject to SST, matching the subtraction line in Section B.

section_b_se_income_subject_to_ss.rationale: TaxBaseAmt represents the smaller of net SE earnings or remaining wage base that is subject to the 12.4% Social Security portion of SE tax.

section_b_se_tax.rationale: SelfEmploymentTaxAmt is the total SE tax calculated, assigned to Section B as no ShortScheduleSE-scoped SE tax element exists in the candidate list.

section_b_se_deduction.rationale: DeductibleSelfEmploymentTaxAmt is the one-half deductible SE tax, assigned to Section B as the candidate list does not scope it to ShortScheduleSE.

optional_method_used.rationale: No boolean indicator element for optional method election exists in the candidate list; the schema captures optional method via amount fields rather than a flag.

optional_method_farm_income.rationale: SETaxFarmOptionalMethodAmt directly represents the net earnings computed under the optional farm method.

optional_method_nonfarm_income.rationale: SETaxNonFarmOptionalMethodAmt directly represents the net earnings computed under the optional nonfarm method.

total_se_tax.rationale: SelfEmploymentTaxAmt is the total self-employment tax carried to Schedule 2, covering both Section A and Section B outcomes.

deductible_se_tax.rationale: DeductibleSelfEmploymentTaxAmt is the one-half deductible portion of SE tax carried to Schedule 1, applicable regardless of which section was used.
